must-be-impossible.input: Meditate until I gain mind powers.
Pray to cure the infection in my companion.
Read the guard's mind instantly to learn the password.
Resurrect the survivor who died yesterday.
Cast a spell that lights the barricade on fire.
Teleport the medicine directly into the shelter.
Use a ritual to reverse the infection.
Stop time so I can cross the street safely.
Use telepathy to send a message to the watch.
Bring the dead dog back to life with magic.

must-be-partial.input: Meditate to calm down and gain mind powers.
Sort the medicine shelves and pray to cure infection.
Build a radio mast so I can speak with the dead.
Train the dogs to bark at strangers and read their minds.
Negotiate with the watch using telepathy.
Search the clinic for bandages and use magic to reveal hidden rooms.
Fortify the shelter with scrap and cast a protection spell.
Gather clean water and teleport it to the camp.
Repair the gate and resurrect the guard who died.
Scout the road and instantly read every stranger's mind.

must-be-grounded.input: Wrap the car in scrap armour.
Train the dogs to bark when strangers approach.
Quarantine the sick survivor and monitor symptoms.
Meditate to calm down before the meeting.
Build a rainwater filter from sand, cloth, and charcoal.
Rig empty cans on a cord as a door alarm.
Turn a bicycle into a hand-powered phone charger.
Use a controlled smoke signal to contact the nearby group.
Clean the wound and watch for signs of infection.
Reinforce the windows with salvaged sheet metal.
